circuit.name: Two Switch Forward DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Isolated DC-DC forward converter with two series primary switches and automatic core demagnetization via clamp diodes D1/D2. Converts 48V input to 5V output at 1A load. Both SW1 and SW2 switch simultaneously (same gate signal). When switches turn OFF, the transformer magnetizing current drives the switch node voltage; D1 (P1 node to VIN+) and D2 (VIN- to P2 node) clamp the primary voltage to VIN and return energy to the source. Core resets in the off-time, requiring duty < 0.5. Secondary uses a forward diode and freewheeling diode with LC output filter.

requirements.requirement: Output voltage regulation at 5V; duty < 0.5 enforced for core reset margin
Efficiency; verify D1/D2 clamp diode loss; measure forward and freewheeling diode conduction

data.name: Id1_avg
data.description: Average clamp diode D1 current (energy returned to source)

requirements.requirement: Switch peak voltage clamped to VIN by D1/D2; verify switches see no more than VIN

outputs.description: Peak SW1 drain-source voltage (should be <= VIN)
